content:
sam: Heads-up — planning offsite agenda draft posted. This year I want to swap one breakout for a customer deep-dive rotation + a short spec sprint.
ana: love that. can we make the deep-dive customer-led? invite 2 power users for 15m each.
jonah: Agreed. For the spec sprint, propose 90m to write vertical-specific acceptance criteria and rollout fences.
marta: I'll run a 30m design critique after the sprint so we can lock UX constraints.
leo: From infra POV we need clear launch criteria so we can size Dedicated capacity; please include perf targets (p95 latency, tokens/sec).
cody: I'll coordinate customer invites and collect top 3 use-cases + sample prompts. deadline for prework: 1 week before offsite.
ana: quick checklist for prework (share with invitees):
```
- 3 use cases (short bullets)
- 5 anonymized example prompts/outputs
- Top support tickets that map to the use cases
- One success metric (e.g., reduction in support ops)
```
sam: Nice. Can we put a tiny decision rubric in the sprint so we don't over-scope? Something like: impact, implementation effort (S/M/L), infra cost delta.
jonah: I'll draft the rubric and share in the doc — will include a column for fallback policy (rollback vs degrade gracefully).
marta: For facilitation: I'll pair with @ana and we can rotate notetaking to capture acceptance criteria + design notes.
leo: Also add a short ops runbook task: who owns cache invalidation and KV migration if we change model format.
cody: Calendar bot — can you create provisional invites for Sep 8-9 offsite and add prework due Aug 31?
calendar-bot: Event created: "Product Offsite — Customer Deep-Dive + Spec Sprint" Sep 8 09:00–17:00 & Sep 9 09:00–13:00. Prework deadline set to 1714896000 (Aug 31). Invitations sent to participants.
ana: Suggested sprint outputs: 3 prioritized specs with acceptance tests, rollout plan (canary gates), and a short fidelity checklist for model quantization/quality.
sam: Goal for the offsite: land on 1 prioritized initiative we can prototype Q4 and have launch criteria by end of offsite. If we finish early, we run a short lightning session: "what would not ship." :head_exploding: 
jonah: Can we also reserve a 45m slot for OKR alignment with GTM — just to validate targeting and success metrics with Sales lead?
cody: I'll ping sales to confirm availability.
marta: Room logistics: projector + breakout boards + sticky notes. Also remote folks: we record design critique and upload to drive.
leo: Perf targets proposal (for discussion): p95 latency < 250ms for 256 tokens, cost delta < 20% vs baseline, hot-path KV hit rate > 90%.
sam: Good starting point. Jonah, can you synthesize a one-pager with rubric + perf targets + prework checklist by EOD Friday? I'll include it in the invite thread.
jonah: Yep — I'll drop the one-pager and the draft rubric here when done.
ana: One more — let's include a 10m "risk radar" at the top of day 1: legal/compliance, infra, quality, customer adoption. quick dot-vote.
sam: Perfect. Thanks all. Action items: jonah (one-pager + rubric), cody (customer invites + sales ping), marta & ana (facilitation + recording plan), leo (ops checklist).
ana: :thumbsup:
jonah: On it. I'll post the doc link in this thread when ready.
calendar-bot: Reminder set: Prework due 48h before offsite to owners and invited customers.
